violation_type.title: Children Handwashing After Outdoor Activities (26 TAC §746.3417(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: After outdoor activities, children did not have their hands washed. Additionally, the children immediately transitioned to lunch time and did not wash their hands prior to eating.

finding_variants.text: After outdoor activities, children did not have their hands washed. Additionally, the children immediately transitioned to lunch time and did not wash their hands prior to eating.
It was found that a caregiver did not take children to wash their hands after coming inside from outdoor activities.
Children were observed coming from the playground outside and not washing their hands.
When the class came in from outside the children did not wash their hands.
The children did not was their hands when they came from outside and before they ate their snack.
During the inspection hand washing did not occur with every child when the children transitioned from outside to inside. This was corrected at inspection.
